people.imagined: Walking on the quay with a rolling gait, pay spent, grinning, being dragged back aboard.
people.subject: The moment: on a lantern-lit quay at dusk, walking with a rolling sailor's swagger, he grins straight at the viewer, pay spent and not sorry. Face: a broad, careless grin showing white teeth; a sunburnt, handsome, rough-cut face, dark eyes, a shadow of stubble, a square jaw, thick black brows with a fine scar cutting through one; a small gold coin-sized earring in one ear. Hair: black, tied in a tail with a vermilion silk ribbon, loose strands lifting in the sea wind. Body: lean, leaning to one side as if the ground still rocked, feet wide, arms swinging. Clothing: a short vermilion silk jacket of a Phượng Minh outer disciple, open over a pale layered under-robe with a crossed collar and a loosened dark-red sash, flame-and-wave embroidery in gold thread along the hem; sleeves rolled to show a small blue wave tattoo on the forearm; a string of brass coins and a small red jade pendant at his hip. Hands and objects: a rope coiled over one shoulder. Slung across his back, the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword rises past the left shoulder, in a red-brown scabbard, the grip wrapped in rust-red cord, a copper guard. Power: a few faint blue and red motes of qi, water and fire, drift near his sword hand like sparks over spray. Background: a blurred harbour of glowing paper lanterns, tall masts and a sky of rose-pink cloud, silver mist on the water. Light: warm gold sunset spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim glow along his cheek, glinting on the gold earring. Expression: a broad, rowdy, careless grin with half-lidded eyes and one brow cocked, happy and unrepentant.

people.imagined: Surfacing from a dive, a tiny bell pendant clenched in her teeth, calm, breath held longer than the man who resents her.
people.subject: The moment: surfacing from a dive in a moonlit sea, water streaming off her, she holds a small bell pendant clamped in her teeth and regards the viewer calmly. Face: a small green-bronze bell on a cord clamped between her bared front teeth, hanging at her chin, bright with wet; a smooth, narrow, brown face, long wet lashes, calm dark eyes, drops of water beading on her lashes, pale cold lips stretched round the bell, cheeks flushed from the effort. Hair: black, plastered to her skull, one long wet braid over a shoulder, a loose strand across her forehead. Body: lean, sleek, shoulders bare to the collarbone, one hand on a boat's rail. Clothing: a short vermilion silk diving jacket of the palace fleet, soaked dark and clinging, with a crossed collar and gold flame-and-wave embroidery at the border, over pale gauze sleeves that float on the water; a red silk cord at her waist with a tiny red jade bead. Hands and objects: one hand gripping the rail of a boat, the other holding a net bag. Power: a thin shimmer of blue qi lies on the water around her shoulders, a few motes of pale light rising with the drops. Background: a blurred sea and the side of a ship, a rope ladder in the water, a low line of dark jungle coast under a mist-silvered sky. Light: cool silver moonlight from the upper left, a soft glow on the wet skin, glitter on the water and on the green of the bell. Expression: a smooth, calm face with steady eyes on the viewer and lips closed round the bell, unbothered and quietly proud.

people.imagined: At the oar bench in the sun, chin held high though his palms are raw; he has just had a deck hand lashed and laughs.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a rowing bench among deck hands in early morning mist, he looks down at the viewer from a great height of pride. Face: his chin lifted so high that the nostrils show, a haughty tilt; a handsome, proud, narrow young face, a long straight nose, light cold eyes, a curl of the mouth; fine straight brows and smooth cheeks, one loose lock hanging over an eye. Hair: black, in a neat knot held by a jade pin and a thin gold band. Body: tall, straight, a little thin, spine stiff, bearing the pain like a prince. Clothing: a fine vermilion silk robe with two crossed collars, sleeves rolled to the elbow over a pale gauze under-sleeve, a gold band on the hem, a dark-red silk sash embroidered with small waves, a jade pendant at his neck and a red jade at the sash with a tassel; clean and rich though he sits at the oar. Hands and objects: both palms, red and blistered, grip the shaft of a long wooden oar. Past the left shoulder rises the rust-red-corded hilt of a plain short slim sword slung on the back, in a red-brown scabbard, the steel darkened to a warm tint. Power: a few pale fire-red motes glimmer at his blistered hands, a young cultivator's first spark. Background: a row of oar benches with bent deck hands, a taut sail and a drummer in the stern, a green-grey sea under drifting mist. Light: soft gold spirit-light from the upper left with a pearl rim light, making his sweat gleam. Expression: chin lifted so far the nostrils show, light cold eyes looking down, a curl of the lip that finds the lash funny.

people.imagined: On the vein fort wall at night, one hand pressed to the stone as if listening to it; he longs to see an enemy sword.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a fort wall at night with one palm flat on the stone, as if listening to it, he looks out at the dark and then at the viewer, hungry for an enemy sword. Face: skin the dull grey of rock, a rock-dust pallor across his face, hands and neck, dust in the creases of his brow; a square, hard, heavy face, a broken nose, small dark eyes with a hard glitter, thick dry lips, a stubborn jaw. Hair: black, cropped short, dusty. Body: thick, solid, a wall of a man, legs set wide, shoulders square, patient as stone. Clothing: a vermilion silk outer robe of the Phượng Minh outer disciples, close-cut for the wall, a crossed collar over a pale under-robe, dust-red border stitched with small flames, a dark-red sash with a bronze buckle and a small red jade pendant; silver-grey metal bracers. Hands and objects: the right palm against the wall; a short plain sword at the hip. A small lamp on a strap glows at his shoulder. Power: a faint grey glimmer of metal qi gathers along his fingers where they touch the stone, with one thread of red fire at the knuckles. Background: a long wall of rough-hewn red-brown stone with a walkway, a signal fire basket on a pole, and the faint line of a pass under a starry sky and low mist. Light: cold blue moonlight from the upper left turns his grey skin almost blue, with a warm orange rim from the signal fire. Expression: a hard, heavy-browed stare from small dark eyes, jaw set stubborn, a restless hunger in the look he gives the dark.

people.imagined: On the fort roof with two signal banners, one hand stained red and one black; she reads a banner across the vein and hopes it does not mean war.
people.subject: The moment: on the roof of a watchtower at dawn, she holds a red banner in one hand and a black banner in the other and looks across the gap between two ridges, hoping the message means peace. Face: the fingertips of her right hand dyed bright red and of the left dyed black, both held up clear; a gentle, round, thoughtful face, calm dark eyes, soft thin straight brows drawn together, a pale complexion, a faint smear of red dye on her chin. Hair: black, in a neat double bun tied with red silk ribbons. Body: slender, standing very straight with arms lifted, shoulders level, patient as a heron. Clothing: a simple graceful vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar and long sleeves tied back with cords, a pale gauze under-collar, a small gold flame stitched at the hem, a dark-red sash with a pouch of dyes and a little red jade bead. Hands and objects: two small plain cloth signal flags, red and black, on short poles, no writing. Power: a few faint red motes of fire qi float up from the red flag like sparks of a lamp. Background: a flat tower roof with a wooden rail, a rack of poles with rolled cloth, a drum, and a far view of two ridges with a pale river of mist between them. Light: clean pearl-pink dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim glow on her hair, the red and black of the flags vivid. Expression: quietly hopeful, her gaze reaching across the distance and her lips pressed together in a small prayer that the banner means peace.

people.imagined: Sorting dried herbs; her nose wrinkles at every smell, even good ones; she knows the fevers by scent.
people.subject: The moment: in a long drying shed, she holds a bundle of dried herbs under her nose and wrinkles it hard, knowing the fevers by scent. Face: nose scrunched in a deep wrinkle, nostrils flared, eyes squeezed half shut; a small, kind, freckled face with a wide mouth, rosy cheeks, small bright eyes, lips slightly parted as she sniffs. Hair: black, in a bun under a pale cloth, herb sprigs stuck in it. Body: small and plump, bending toward the bundle, shoulders raised. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of soft vermilion silk with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled and tied back with green cords, a leaf-green silk apron-sash embroidered with small flames along its edge, a string of dried peppers round her neck, a little red jade bead at her waist; her hands are stained green to the wrist. Hands and objects: a dried bundle in each hand; a basket of herbs hangs from her back. Power: a few faint green motes of wood qi drift up from the herbs like pollen. Background: blurred racks of hanging herbs in rows, a table with a scale and small stone mortars, a doorway opening on a green rice field in mist. Light: warm golden spirit-light through the slats from the upper left, a soft glow on her freckled cheeks. Expression: flustered and wincing, a kind face caught mid-sniff, the mouth a little open and the whole look bright with honest effort.

people.imagined: In the granary, knocking on a bin and listening, knuckles to wood, head cocked.
people.subject: The moment: in a dim granary, he knocks on a wooden grain bin with one knuckle, head cocked, listening to the grain. Face: one knuckle raised and rapping the bin, his head tilted to it; a patient, broad, weathered face, grey stubble, closed eyes, a faint smile, bushy grey brows, deep lines, lips folded over missing teeth. Hair: grey-black, tied in a pale cloth, a few grey hairs sticking out. Body: sturdy and bent, one hand flat on the bin, a long-practised stoop. Clothing: a plain but clean robe of undyed silk-cotton in a servant's cut, crossed collar and plain vermilion edging at the cuffs, a wide ochre sash with a wooden measure and a small red jade charm hanging from it, a cloth at the neck, straw shoes. Hands and objects: a wooden shovel against his shoulder. Power: none beyond a faint ochre glimmer of earth qi on the grain dust, as soft as pollen in the light. Background: long wooden bins in a row in the dim granary, each marked with a daub of paint, a ladder, a small window, and a cat asleep on a sack, mist of dust drifting. Light: a bar of dusty gold spirit-light from a window falls across him from the upper left, with a pale rim glow on the grey stubble. Expression: eyes shut, a slow easy smile, the stillness of a man who has heard this granary breathe for fifty years.

people.imagined: Tuning a qin by the dawn flute, her fingertips grooved by the strings.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a qin in a luthier's shop at first light, she has just plucked one string and looks up as the note settles. Face: deep straight grooves, one per string, across the pads of her raised fingertips, a row of seven clearly visible; a calm, pale, delicate face, a straight nose, still dark eyes, fine straight brows, long lashes, pale lips. Hair: black, in a smooth low bun with a plain silver pin and a vermilion ribbon. Body: slim, upright, seated, shoulders soft. Clothing: a graceful robe of pale vermilion silk with two crossed collars, a grey gauze over-sleeve tied back with a white cord, hem borders embroidered with tiny gold flames and clouds, a dark-red sash with a small tuning key on a cord and a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a dark lacquered qin on a table, its silk strings catching the light. Power: faint silver-grey ripples of qi spread from the string like rings in water, with a few motes. Background: a luthier's shop with qin of various sizes on racks, coils of silk thread, a bench with tools, and a screen painted with bamboo, softened in mist. Light: soft grey-white dawn spirit-light from a paper window on the upper left, with a pale glow along the strings. Expression: still and attentive, her gaze lowered to the strings and her lips quiet while she waits for the sound to finish.

people.imagined: Behind the counter in the shop, playing a stock flute while the owner is out; reeds behind each ear, half asleep.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a shop counter while the owner is out, he plays a stock flute lazily, half asleep. Face: a thin bamboo reed tucked behind each ear, sticking up like antennae; a young, loose, sleepy face, a lopsided grin round the flute, thin uneven brows, smooth cheeks, lips a little too wide. Hair: black, spiky, a vermilion ribbon tied crooked in it. Body: lanky, slouched, elbows on the counter, legs crossed. Clothing: a graceful but rumpled robe of vermilion silk, crossed collar crooked, sleeves wide and crumpled with a smudge of oil, a loose dark-red sash with a string of copper coins and a red jade bead, small flame embroidery fading at the hem; he wears one sandal and holds the other. Hands and objects: a flute at his lips. Power: a few pale grey motes of metal qi drift off the flute stops in time with the note. Background: a narrow shop crowded with flutes and reed organs in rows, a counter with a cash box, a sleeping cat, a rack of reed pipes in graduated sizes, a door open to a lantern-lit lane in soft mist. Light: warm lantern spirit-light from the door at the upper left glowing on the flute, a faint rim light on his spiky hair. Expression: drowsy and careless, eyelids heavy, a boneless easy contentment that does not mind being caught.

people.imagined: At night before the furnace, watching for the colour change, eyelids red from glare.
people.subject: The moment: sitting cross-legged before a furnace at night, he watches the fire without blinking, waiting for the colour to change. Face: reddened, swollen eyelids glowing, red-rimmed from the furnace glare; a calm, thin, young face lit orange, steady attentive eyes, eyebrows singed short, lean cheeks, chapped lips. Hair: black, tied in a pale cloth. Body: slim, sitting with his back straight and hands on his knees, perfectly still as if carved. Clothing: a simple vermilion silk robe with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled and tied back, a few small burn marks at the cuffs, a wet cloth round his neck, a dark-red sash with a small red jade bead, thin gold flame embroidery at the hem catching the light. Hands and objects: a long iron poker across his knees; a small clay cup of cold tea by his knee and a bundle of spare charcoal sticks at his side. Power: ripples of heat rise from him and the coals, with a few bright red motes of fire qi floating up toward the dark. Background: a great bronze furnace with a mouth of red coals and a chimney going up into darkness, a stack of charcoal, a water barrel with a dipper, mist of smoke. Light: the furnace glow lights only the front of his face in copper-orange; the rest is shadow. Expression: unblinking, patient and still, the lids red and heavy and the lean face lit like a lantern.

people.imagined: Climbing to the furnace with a basket of cassia bark, smiling, trusting everyone.
people.subject: The moment: climbing a path with a basket of cassia bark on her back, she smiles shyly at the viewer, trusting everyone. Face: a basket of curled brown cassia bark piled high on her back, scrolls of bark; a round, rosy, open face, big shy eyes, a small smile, thin arched brows, full lips. Hair: black, in two plaits with green silk cord and small leaf-shaped jade beads. Body: small and sturdy, leaning forward under the weight, small careful steps. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of soft vermilion silk with a crossed collar and sleeves rolled up, a sash of faded green silk embroidered with tiny cassia leaves and flames, a small pouch of cassia sticks and a red jade bead at her hip, grass-tied sandals. Hands and objects: the basket's straps held in both hands; a few curled strips of bark have fallen on to the path behind her. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi and a few drifting golden motes hang round the bark like sweet smoke. Background: a steep path of red earth with stone steps climbing to a distant smoking chimney, cassia trees along it, mist and a wide sky of pale cloud. Light: soft rose-gold spirit-light from the upper left, a warm glow bringing out the reddish brown of the bark. Expression: open and bashful, her eyes lowered a little, cheeks pink, a trusting look with no guard in it at all.

people.imagined: At the Ash Seat with the bell at her wrist, silenced by a cloth pinched around the clapper.
people.subject: The moment: at the lip of a great vent, she stands with her wrist raised, a bell silenced by a pinch of cloth, her head bowed in reverence. Face: a bronze bell at the wrist with a small wad of cloth pinched in its mouth, held at the front; a calm, devout, round face, lowered lids, a soft mouth, straight calm brows, clear pale skin. Hair: black, in a low knot with a gold phoenix hairpin and a single red ribbon. Body: slim, upright, very still, wrist raised in ritual stillness. Clothing: a robe of Phượng Minh vermilion silk of an inner disciple, a crossed collar over two pale under-collars in dawn-orange, wide long sleeves with gold phoenix-feather embroidery at the cuffs, a dark red silk sash with a red jade disc and tassel, a thin red cord with a small bronze charm. Hands and objects: a small bronze charm on a thin red cord, held close in her free hand. Power: a soft red-orange shimmer of fire qi gathers about her bowed head and hands, a few embers floating up from the vent. Background: a black stone ledge at the lip of a great vent, a bronze tripod censer with smoke, a second bell hanging on a post, and a dim red glow filling a cavern of mist. Light: orange glow from below, cool silver-grey from above, a thin warm rim light on her cheek. Expression: reverent and apart, her lowered gaze keeping its own silence while the vent breathes beside her.

people.imagined: In the kitchen, showing a ladle burn up the back of her hand like a medal and seating guests by whim.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a steaming pot with a ladle, she holds up the back of her hand to show a long burn proudly, like a medal. Face: a long shiny pink ladle burn running up the back of her hand and wrist, held up for all to see; a round, red, jolly face, grey hair, bushy grey brows, a small mole on her chin, a gap between her front teeth, bright eyes. Hair: grey, in a bun tied with a vermilion cloth. Body: stout and strong, feet planted, one hand on her hip, broad and solid. Clothing: a plain, clean servant's robe of undyed silk-cotton with a crossed collar and a thin vermilion edging, a white apron-sash, sleeves rolled to the elbow over thick forearms, a string of garlic at her waist, flat worn slippers. Hands and objects: an iron ladle; a steaming pot. Power: none, only golden steam and a few warm motes in the haze. Background: a long kitchen with a row of iron pots on a brick stove, dried fish on the wall, a table piled with bowls, and a young kitchen boy hiding behind the door, thick mist of steam. Light: warm firelight and steam-glow from the upper left, a soft gold haze around her. Expression: loud and delighted, the brows high and the grin wide, a woman thrilled with her own scar.

people.imagined: Looking around to see who is watching before smiling, a letter to write tonight.
people.subject: The moment: in a courtyard, he glances sidelong over his shoulder to see who is watching before smiling a beat late, a letter hidden in his sleeve for tonight. Face: a smile that comes a beat late, after the eyes have swept left and right; a handsome, friendly, open face, a wide mouth, quick dark eyes, thick straight brows, a broad nose, full lips. Hair: black, tied in a tail with a vermilion ribbon and a small silver pin. Body: broad and easy, one foot turned slightly toward the door, shoulders a little too stiff for the easy stance. Clothing: a graceful vermilion silk robe of a Phượng Minh outer disciple, crossed collar, new and clean, a clan-red band wound round the wrist, a small clan flame stitched at the collar, a dark-red sash with a red jade pendant. Hands and objects: a folded letter half hidden in his sleeve, the knuckles of that hand white around the paper. Power: a faint red glimmer of fire qi flickers at his fingertips, quickly hidden. Background: a stone courtyard with a well, a row of practising disciples, a closed door, and at the edge of the frame the dark shape of a man in a grey cloak, mist at the stones. Light: soft warm gold spirit-light of late afternoon from the upper left, a sharp shadow and a pale rim light. Expression: a friendly, practised warmth that arrives just too late to be natural.

people.imagined: In the bamboo court with her silver hair tied in a bamboo ring, patient with her master.
people.subject: The moment: in a bamboo court at morning, she stands with her hands folded, smiling patiently at her master. Face: silver-fine, white-grey hair at only twenty, long and shining, tied in a ring of bamboo; a young, gentle face, smooth cheeks, soft grey-brown eyes, pale brows, thin calm lips. Hair: silver-white, gathered at the nape in a bamboo ring with a small jade leaf pin. Body: slim, upright, respectful. Clothing: a simple graceful robe of pale vermilion silk with two crossed collars, a bamboo-green silk sash with fine flame and leaf embroidery on the border, sleeves tied back with green cord, a herb pouch and a small red jade bead at her hip. Hands and objects: a small pot of herbs held in her hands, a young herb with three pale-green leaves in it, a bamboo ladle resting across it. Power: a few pale green motes of wood qi float over the young herb and catch in her silver hair. Background: a bamboo courtyard with rows of herb pots on a low wall, a stone bench, a tall clump of green culms, and an old man's figure far off, drifting mist. Light: soft silver-gold morning spirit-light from the upper left, her hair shining like moonlit thread. Expression: unhurried and kind, the look of someone who has all the patience a slow master needs.

people.imagined: At the spring fair, whistling through the gap between her front teeth, a flute-maker's ear turning.
people.subject: The moment: at a spring fair among paper lanterns, she whistles a clear note through the gap in her front teeth and grins at the viewer, a flute-maker's ear turning. Face: a clear gap between the two front teeth in an open grin; a round, bright, freckled face, brown eyes, a snub nose, thick brows, a flush high on her cheeks, a tiny silver stud in her left ear. Hair: black, in two buns tied with red thread, a little tassel bobbing from each. Body: small and springy, shoulders back, chin raised, light on her feet. Clothing: a graceful simple vermilion silk robe of an outer disciple with a crossed collar, sleeves rolled, the hem hitched on one side over a pale under-skirt, gold flame stitching at the border, a dark-red sash with a small silk lantern charm and a red jade bead. Hands and objects: a small bamboo whistle on a thread dangling from her fingers, a paper lantern, a ribbon of red paper fluttering from her sleeve. Power: a few sweet green motes of wood qi dance round the whistle with the note. Background: a spring fair with stalls and strings of paper lanterns glowing, a crowd of villagers, a flute-seller's booth, a pale-blue evening sky with mist. Light: warm lantern spirit-light from the upper left, the red of the lantern glowing on her cheeks. Expression: wide-eyed, delighted and trusting, the whole face bright with the joy of the sound she just made.

people.imagined: Bowing too deeply to a host with a gift held in both hands, whispering a flattering lie.
people.subject: The moment: in a long hall, he bows too deeply to a host with a gift held in both hands and glances up with a sweet smile, whispering a flattering lie. Face: a bow a hand's width deeper than needed, the forehead nearly to the box; a smooth, mild, boyish face, soft warm brown eyes, soft straight brows, a slight sweet smile. Hair: black, in a neat knot with a gold pin and a vermilion ribbon. Body: slim, bowing from the waist, back straight, arms extended, every line polished. Clothing: a fine robe of vermilion silk with two crossed collars and a pale gauze under-collar, wide clean sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with gold phoenix feathers, a dark-red sash with a red jade pendant and a silk tassel, white-soled shoes; the cleanest and best-pressed envoy's dress. Hands and objects: a lacquered box held in both hands, a red silk tassel hanging from it; a second box wrapped in blue cloth with a neat bow waits on the floor at his side. Power: a faint gentle red glimmer of fire qi lies over the lacquer like reflected lamplight. Background: a long hall with a polished floor, a row of servants waiting, a red screen painted with a bird, a lamp, soft mist. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left, shining on the lacquered lid, a gentle rim on his cheek. Expression: sweet and sincere on the surface, the eyes warm and the mouth quietly false.

people.imagined: Before dawn on the stair, tracing the fan-edge scar on her cheek as she lies to a rival.
people.subject: The moment: on a red stair before dawn, she touches her scarred cheek with a fingertip while smiling falsely at a rival. Face: a thin pale scar down the left cheek from a fan's edge, traced with her finger; a sharp, pretty, narrow face, a pointed chin, bright black eyes, fine straight brows, thin lips. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a red silk cord and a small gold flame pin. Body: lean and quick, one shoulder forward, weight on the back foot, ready to move. Clothing: a graceful vermilion silk robe with crossed collars, sleeves rolled and tied, dawn-orange under-collar, gold flame embroidery along the hem, a dark-red sash with a bamboo water flask and a red jade bead, cloth-wrapped sandals. Hands and objects: a red fan in the left hand; a grey towel over her shoulder. Power: a thin trail of red fire qi curls from the fan's edge, with a few sparks. Background: a long stair of red stone in the pale dawn with a few disciples practising in pairs, a banner of plain red, the dark line of a wall, thin mist. Light: pink dawn spirit-light from the upper left picks out the pale line of the scar, with a hot rim glow. Expression: a pretty, false sweetness, the black eyes sharp underneath it, ambition held close.

people.imagined: Pausing under the great wutong and looking up, as she does every time, at the leaves.
people.subject: The moment: pausing under the great wutong tree, she looks up at the leaves, as she does every time, then glances back. Face: her face tipped up, eyes on the leaves, dappled light moving on it; a gentle, pale, round face, thin calm brows, a few fine freckles dusting her nose, parted lips. Hair: black, in a braid tied with a strip of green silk and a small jade leaf. Body: slight, weight even, neck lengthened as she looks up, open and unguarded. Clothing: a graceful simple robe of pale vermilion silk with a crossed collar and long sleeves, a leaf-green sash embroidered with tiny wutong leaves and flames, a small seed charm and a red jade bead at her neck. Hands and objects: an empty reed basket held loosely at her hip, a single dropped leaf landed on its rim. Power: slow green motes of wood qi drift down with the leaves and gather round her braid. Background: an enormous rough trunk fills the left of the frame with leaves the size of dishes drifting down, a stone path, a small stone lantern, mist. Light: dappled green-gold spirit-light from the upper left flickers down on to her face. Expression: wondering and cautious, as if the tree might say something to her.

people.imagined: Barefoot on the hot rock at the lip of the vent, a folded note in his sleeve, looking up as someone climbs towards him.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot on hot black rock at the lip of a vent, bent and tall, a grand elder looks up as someone climbs toward him, a folded note in his sleeve. Face: white crusted salt-burn scars running up both bare forearms, pale chalk-white against brown skin, held at his sides; a long, lean, deeply lined face, a heavy brow, a long hooked nose, short white stubble, tired grey eyes with a faint orange reflection from the vent, a pale cleft scar on his chin. Hair: grey-white, long, tied in a plain knot with a hemp cord and a dull gold pin. Body: very tall, stooped at the shoulders, long arms; soles and hands leathery and cracked. Clothing: layered ash-grey and deep vermilion silk of a Grand Elder, a vent keeper's robe with three crossed collars, short sleeves worn over long gauze under-sleeves, plain but rich, dark-gold phoenix-feather borders gone sooty, a heavy red jade at the sash, no crown; bare feet on the rock. Hands and objects: a bronze censer hung from a chain in his right hand with a single ember glowing; his left hand at his sleeve where a folded paper of pale red-ink-stained paper shows, creased soft with age. Power: a strong, steady glow of red fire qi pours up from the vent around his legs and robe hem, embers and heat-haze rising with long threads of orange light. Background: a blurred vent with orange glow far below, black rock, thick mist. Light: orange glow from below and the right, cool grey above, a gold rim light on the white hair. Expression: patient and honest, tired from keeping a fire alive, the long face stubborn and still.

people.imagined: Night in the Hall of Righteousness, a map of the Tower's border spread under one lamp. He has just laid one fan of a pair on the map and put his hand on the pendant of red jade at his collar; the lightning scar down his side shows where his robe has fallen open.
people.subject: The moment: at night in the Hall of Righteousness beside one lamp, a war elder rests his hand on a red jade pendant at his throat and stares at the viewer with grim, steady grief; his robe has fallen open a hand's width on the left. Face: a broad, heavy, grey-bearded face, a thick square-cut grey beard to the chest, a broad nose, deep lines from nose to mouth, heavy grey brows over small dark eyes that do not blink; down the left side of his neck, from the ear into the open collar, a branching white-pink lightning scar like a fern frond. Hair: iron grey, thick, tied in a high knot with a red cord and a plain bronze pin. Body: big, broad-chested, thick-necked, solid as a pillar, sitting very upright. Clothing: a rich vermilion silk robe of a Truong Lão with a wide crossed collar over three layers of dawn-orange and gold, heavy brocade sleeves with gold phoenix and flame embroidery, a dark-red sash; over it a coat of red-lacquered scale armour with the lacquer over the left breast newer and brighter than the rest; the hem edged with all five narrow bands. Hands and objects: his left hand holds the red jade pendant, a small carved disc, against his chest; on the map beside him lies one folded red feather fan, its twin missing. Power: a deep, banked red glow of fire qi lies under his skin and robes, ember motes rising slowly round his shoulders in the dark. Background: a blurred dark hall, a map with brown mountain shapes and no writing, a single lamp, drifting mist. Light: a lamp from the lower left, warm orange, deep shadow behind, a thin red rim. Expression: unmoving and grim, the grey eyes wet with an old grief that has hardened into resolve.

people.imagined: Morning at the Wutong Court. He has just come out to the steps loudly, as he always does, birds on both shoulders, seeds spilling from his pockets, and has spotted a visitor; he booms a greeting while one hand quietly rests on a bark-rough trunk behind him.
people.subject: The moment: at the top of a stair in the Wutong Court at morning, a first elder is mid-shout, one arm spread wide in a loud greeting while two spirit birds sit on his shoulders. Face: a red-crested bird the size of a pigeon, scarlet crest and green back, perched on his right shoulder, and on his left shoulder a hawk-sized red bird whose long tail feathers end in black char, both close to his face and clear; a big, loud, round, ruddy face, a wide laughing mouth, thick brown brows, a bulbous nose, bright black eyes, a thick black beard flecked with grey. Hair: black and grey, thick and wild, in a topknot with a green silk cord and a few bright feathers. Body: huge, tall and broad, barrel-chested, a big belly, big hands. Clothing: a long robe of rich green silk with three crossed collars and wide sleeves, sewn all over with pressed lacquered brown wutong leaves in gold thread, streaked white with bird lime at the shoulders, a dark green silk sash with a jade pendant, the hem edged with gold and green bands. Hands and objects: a handful of pale seeds spilling from his right fist, more bulging his sleeve pockets; behind him a rough grey trunk. Power: a bright green and scarlet shimmer of wood and fire qi wraps his shoulders and the birds, motes and feather-light sparks drifting into the boughs. Background: a blurred stair and giant wutong boughs in green mist. Light: bright dappled morning spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim on the feathers. Expression: booming and delighted, eyes crinkled and brows high, a man who cannot keep a greeting quiet.

people.imagined: The Nest at night, hundreds of fire-silk threads taut in the air like a loom. She stands among them turning a reel of grey thread in one hand and watching the lattice for a thread that has frayed.
people.subject: The moment: inside the Nest at night, standing within a lattice of taut orange-gold silk threads, she turns a reel of grey thread and looks narrowly at the viewer for a thread about to give way. Face: burn-calloused fingertips, thick, shiny, brown-pink pads on every finger of the hand that turns the reel, held near her chin; a thin, sharp, hollow-cheeked face, a long nose, thin lips, tight clever dark eyes, deep lines between the brows. Hair: black with grey, scraped into a tight bun pinned with a long iron needle and a small gold phoenix pin. Body: thin, wiry, upright, shoulders high. Clothing: a robe of very old, faded orange-red silk restitched along its seams in many slightly different reds, over a vermilion inner robe and a pale gauze collar, wide sleeves with fine gold fire-silk embroidery, a dark-red sash, a hem edged with gold and white bands, a small wooden thimble ring on each finger. Hands and objects: the grey reel in the right hand; a small array banner with a single orange thread hem on a short pole in the left; a square carved stone seal hanging at the waist. Power: warm red-orange light runs through the threads like a pulse, drawing a soft shimmer of fire qi round her hands. Background: a blurred web of glowing thread-lines in the dark, mist between them. Light: warm orange glow along the threads and from the lower right, a gold rim on her cheek. Expression: guarded and cool, the mouth flat and the gaze measuring every fibre of what stands in front of her.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Rites, the score archive around her; the funeral drum at her side. She has been tapping out the eighth movement on the table without noticing and has just stopped, as if the missing bar had spoken.
people.subject: The moment: in the Hall of Rites among the score archive, she has been tapping out the eighth movement on the table and has just stopped, as if the missing bar had spoken; the funeral drum stands at her side. Face: the fingertips of her right hand flat and wide like a musician's, pads flattened and shiny, caught mid-tap on the wood; a long face, long jaw, long straight nose, high forehead, pale skin, deep-set serious dark eyes, a firm thin mouth. Hair: black, in a severe long knot with a bare black-lacquered pin. Body: tall, thin, straight, long neck. Clothing: an over-robe of black silk embroidered all over with tiny musical marks in red thread, a bare patch at the hem left plain and unstitched, wide gauze sleeves; underneath a vermilion silk robe with two crossed collars, a dark-red sash with a jade pendant, the hem edged with gold and green bands. Hands and objects: a seven-stringed dark zither on the table with one string visibly broken and curled; a small leather funeral drum at her elbow; an old pair of wooden beat-sticks and a small bronze chime hang on the wall. Power: faint green and gold ripples of wood qi hang in the air like the last of a note. Background: a blurred wall of scroll racks, dim, drifting mist. Light: a pale grey spirit-light from a window on the upper left, a faint silver rim. Expression: stubborn patient attention, eyes lifted and fixed on a sound only she can hear.

people.imagined: At the go board with the head, one stone turning in his fingers; he has just seen that a letter did not reach its reader, and he does not show it, an ink-stained hand lying quiet.
people.subject: The moment: at a go board with the head, he turns a stone slowly between his fingers; he has just seen that a letter did not reach its reader and shows nothing, an ink-stained hand lying quiet. Face: a clearly handsome, soft-featured face, a straight nose, fine brows, large dark gentle eyes, a clean-shaven jaw; ink stains on the side of the right hand lying on the board; a smooth black stone between the fingers of his left. Hair: glossy black, in a neat high knot with a red silk cord and a small gold phoenix pin. Body: tall, slender, relaxed and perfectly upright. Clothing: a flowing robe of clear vermilion silk of a chief disciple, three crossed collars in vermilion, dawn-orange and white, wide sleeves with a fine gold phoenix-feather border, cut like the plumage robe but plain in its pattern, a dark-red silk sash, a single gold band on the hem, at his collar a disc of red jade on a cord. Hands and objects: a black go stone between thumb and finger of the left hand; a wooden go board with scattered stones, the white stones ahead; a small fan with a short red-feather plume and a cup of tea steaming untouched at his elbow. Power: a soft vermilion glow of fire qi sits about his shoulders, the lamp flame beside him perfectly still. Background: a blurred room, a lamp, a screen, a thread of mist. Light: soft warm spirit-light from the upper left with a gold rim on his cheek and knot. Expression: courteous and unreadable, the gentle eyes taking in everything and offering back only a polite half-smile.

people.imagined: 480, the empty ridge: the founder at a hundred and fifty, a wandering flute player come home, sitting under a young wutong with his flute resting on his knee, looking at the bare hill he will fill.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at a hundred and fifty, a wandering flute player come home, sitting under a young wutong on the empty ridge with his flute across his knee, looking at the bare hill he will fill. Face: a lean, kindly, travel-lined face, a high forehead, a long straight nose, a thin dark moustache and a short pointed beard, warm patient eyes under level brows, a faint line of a smile. Hair: black, long, tied in a plain knot with a strip of cloth and a simple pale jade pin. Body: tall, narrow, easy, sitting cross-legged on a flat stone, shoulders relaxed. Clothing: a flowing travelling robe of fine grey-brown silk with three crossed collars, a long pale gauze cloak over his shoulders lifted by the wind, wide sleeves with a faint dawn-orange border of small clouds, a rope-and-silk belt with a plain jade pendant; clean and graceful though dusty at the hem. Hands and objects: a long pale bamboo flute across his knees, held lightly in both hands; at his side a small cloth bundle, a water gourd and a walking staff of plain bamboo. Power: a soft pale-gold shimmer of qi and a few red and green motes drift from the flute, drawn in faint wash. Background: a bare windy ridge and a slender wutong sapling, a pale sky with long mist. Light: soft dawn spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: a gentle, resolved calm, the warm eyes resting on the bare hill as if already seeing halls on it.

people.imagined: Dawn, walking the paddies before a council, trousers rolled to the knee, mud to the shin. He has stopped at a dyke to look at the rice and a little of the cloth of his council robe is tucked up in his belt.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a dyke between flooded paddies, barefoot, he looks up from the rice with a mild smile, his council robe tucked up round his waist. Face: a short, sun-browned man with a round, creased face, a wide nose, a thin grey moustache, bright kind small eyes; trousers rolled above the knee and mud to the shin, the bare brown legs plain in the frame. Hair: grey, in a short knot with a rice-straw cord and a plain pin, a straw hat hung at his back. Body: short, sturdy, thick-legged, solid. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe of a council elder with crossed collars over a dawn-orange under-robe and wide sleeves rolled up, hitched into the sash so that the hem with its gold and green bands and gold phoenix-feather embroidery does not touch the water, a dark-red silk sash with a red jade pendant. Hands and objects: a young green rice stalk held in one hand; a small wooden rake over his shoulder; a small clay jug of rice wine hangs from his belt by a cord. Power: a gentle green and ochre shimmer of wood and earth qi lies over the young rice, soft golden motes rising like pollen. Background: a paddy glittering with pink dawn water and a line of far hills in mist. Light: low rose-gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a soft rim light on the creased face. Expression: mild and kind, eyes warm and crinkled, a man more at home with the shoots than with the council.

people.imagined: At the cinnabar furnace on Chu Sa Tuyền, the spring running hot and red behind her. She has just tasted a pill's powder and her lips are red; the fever flush that never leaves her face is bright, and her eyes are already on the next batch.
people.subject: The moment: at the cinnabar furnace on Chu Sa Tuyền with a hot red spring behind her, she touches her tongue to a pinch of red powder from a spoon and then looks sharply at the viewer. Face: lips stained bright red with cinnabar, a plain scarlet mouth, and a permanent flush of fever on both cheekbones, bright pink-red spots on pale skin; a sharp-chinned, narrow face, hollow cheeks, a thin straight nose, hot narrow dark eyes, a bead of sweat at the temple. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a long red-lacquer pin and a gold phoenix hairpin; a few strands damp on the brow. Body: thin, sharp-shouldered, tense. Clothing: a flowing vermilion silk robe of a Truong Lão with two crossed collars over a pale-gold under-robe, wide sleeves tied back with cords, gold flame embroidery on the border, a dark-red silk sash with a small red jade pendant, a clean red-lacquered alchemist's overskirt; fingers stained. Hands and objects: a small bronze spoon in the right hand with a pinch of red powder on it; on a table a row of little clay pill jars. Power: a strong red-gold glow of fire qi shimmers round her hands and the furnace, pill-light and sparks rising in the steam. Background: a blurred furnace mouth with orange coals and a pool of steaming red water in mist. Light: orange furnace glow from the right and a pale grey spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: hungry and exact, the red-stained mouth pressed shut while her mind has already moved on to the next batch.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Trust at the end of the day, three keys on a red cord at her collar. A silk broker's daughter, she weighs the viewer the way she would a bolt of silk, and has just decided what they are worth.
people.subject: The moment: seated in the Hall of Trust at the end of the day, she looks at the viewer through heavy lids with a merchant's cool appraisal, three keys hanging at her breast; a silk broker's daughter, she has just decided what they are worth. Face: three large iron keys of different sizes hanging on a red cord at her chest, bright and clear in the frame; a handsome, heavy-lidded, oval face, a long straight nose, full lips painted a dark rust red, calm dark eyes half closed, smooth olive skin. Hair: black, in an elaborate high coiffure held with gold pins and a comb of red lacquer. Body: full, upright, composed, relaxed. Clothing: a wide-sleeved robe of heavy silk brocade the colour of old embers, dark rust-orange woven with fine gold thread in small flame shapes, over a vermilion silk under-robe and a pale gauze collar, a dark-red sash, the hem edged with gold and green bands, red jade pendants at the sash. Hands and objects: the right hand rests lightly on the keys; the left holds a small ivory abacus; a tray of tea and two small cups stands untouched at her elbow, with a small brass scale. Power: a warm red-gold glow of fire and earth qi lies on the gold thread and the keys like lamplight. Background: a blurred hall with shelves of lacquered boxes, a thread of incense mist. Light: warm lamp spirit-light from the upper left, glinting on the gold thread and a pale rim on her cheek. Expression: cool, measuring and unhurried, a stillness that already carries a price.

people.imagined: On the quay at Thạch Cơ with a ship behind him, mid-laugh; he has come up from a dive and is taking a slow breath, still wet, bare shoulders shining, and hears his own laugh come back off the hull.
people.subject: The moment: on the quay at Thạch Cơ in strong sun, wet from a dive, the admiral laughs hugely with his head thrown back, drawing a slow, deep breath and hearing his own laugh come back off the hull. Face: a huge booming laugh, mouth wide open, strong white teeth; a salt-cracked, brown, weathered face, deep crow's-feet, a broad nose, thick black eyebrows beaded with water, a short salt-and-pepper beard. Hair: black with grey, wet, tied in a short tail with a red silk band; water drips on to his shoulders. Body: big-shouldered, deep-chested, thick arms, a diver's barrel chest rising with the breath. Clothing: a flowing vermilion silk jacket hanging open and wet over a pale silk under-robe, soaked dark with seawater, wide sleeves with gold phoenix and wave embroidery, a rope-and-silk belt with a large red jade, the hem edged with gold and white bands; trousers rolled. Hands and objects: a heavy diver's lead weight on a cord in one fist; in the other a wet coil of rope. Power: a deep blue and red shimmer of water and fire qi steams from his shoulders and the wet silk, sparkling droplets rising as motes of light. Background: a ship's hull with a red pennant and a bright sea, a row of coiled hawsers and barrels on the quay, two sailors pointing out to sea, sea mist. Light: strong sun spirit-light from the upper left, glittering on the water drops, a white rim on his shoulders. Expression: roaring, delighted, eyes shining, a man whose joy is bigger than his fleet.

people.imagined: On the wall of the vein fort at dusk, in armour whose seams are red with cinnabar dust. She has come out to look at the pass and is turning back; the thunder-burn along her jaw has caught the last light.
people.subject: The moment: on the wall of the vein fort at dusk, armoured, she has come out to look at the pass and turns to look squarely at the viewer, jaw set; the thunder-burn along her jaw has caught the last light. Face: a pale, shiny thunder burn spread like a small fern along the line of her jaw from ear to chin, standing out against weathered skin; a square, hard face, a short broad nose, thick black brows, level dark eyes. Hair: black, cropped short, a few grey hairs, bound with a red band. Body: stocky, square-shouldered, planted, large red-brown hands. Clothing: a suit of red-lacquered scale armour with the scales edged in cinnabar red, cinnabar dust in every seam at the collar, over a vermilion silk robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves bound at the wrist, gold phoenix and flame borders, a dark red sash, the hem edged with gold and white bands; a leather gauntlet on one hand, the other bare and red. Hands and objects: a pair of closed red fans, one at her belt, one held low in her right hand; a small bronze watch-horn at her hip beside a rolled map-case, a hawk feather in her helmet strap. Power: a heavy red glow of fire qi gathers round her armour and fans, with faint blue-white forks of thunder-light along the burn. Background: a blurred stone parapet and a violet pass far below, low cloud. Light: low red dusk spirit-light from the upper left, a gold rim along the armour. Expression: hard and unforgiving, the pale scar bright along the set jaw, eyes that have counted every cost.

people.imagined: Late evening in his guest room, back against the wall as always; a small clay figure half-shaped in his hands, a shelf of them behind him all facing a window.
people.subject: The moment: late evening in his guest room, back against the wall as always, a guest elder shapes a small clay figure in his hands and looks up with a calm, reserved gaze; behind him a shelf of identical figures all face a window. Face: a narrow, grey-skinned, long face, grey eyes, a long thin nose, thin lips, a grey stubble, deep lines; a thin streak of white runs from the left temple. Hair: grey, short, combed flat, held by a plain silver pin. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, sitting very straight against the wall. Clothing: flowing guest's robes of pale grey silk with three crossed collars, open at the throat over an inner collar of vivid deep Tower blue, a sash of undyed silk with a small blue jade pendant, wide sleeves, no hem bands; the plain dress of a guest, not a member. Hands and objects: a half-formed grey clay figure the size of a finger in his hands; a long row of identical tiny clay figures on the shelf behind him; on the table a straight sword in a plain blue scabbard, a cloth beside it for cleaning. Power: a quiet grey-silver shimmer of metal qi lies along the sword, with a thread of blue water mist at the scabbard and one faint red mote. Background: a blurred shelf and a dark window, drifting mist. Light: lamp spirit-light from the upper left, grey-gold, a pale silver rim on his hair. Expression: reserved and still, the eyes lowered to the clay, his mouth closed on whatever he is not saying.

people.imagined: On the Fire Court stair at dawn with a closed fan pointing at a pupil's wrist: 'there'. Her sleeves are burnt to the elbow and she barks the correction.
people.subject: The moment: on the Fire Court stair at dawn she points a closed red fan sharply at the viewer's wrist like a teacher's rod and barks the correction: there. Face: both bare forearms thick with burn freckles, dark pink dots in hundreds, held out in front; a lean, bony face, burn-freckled across the nose and cheeks, a sharp chin, bright impatient hazel eyes, a thin mouth, singed-short lashes, a small burn mark by her left ear. Hair: red-brown, in a high plait pinned up with a gold phoenix pin, fine strands escaping at her temples. Body: lean, wiry, forward-leaning, quick. Clothing: a vermilion silk robe of a Truong Lão with crossed collars over dawn-orange gauze, both wide sleeves burned off short at the elbow with the scorched edge trimmed clean and re-embroidered in gold flames, a dark red sash with a string of small bronze rings, one for each pupil who passed a test, the hem edged with gold and white bands, leather bracers. Hands and objects: a closed red feather fan used as a pointer in the right hand. Power: a bright red-orange shimmer of fire qi coils round the fan and her forearms, sparks flicking up in the cold air. Background: a red stone stair with a row of young disciples in mist. Light: bright pink-gold dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a hot rim glow on her hair. Expression: impatient and exact, the glare of a teacher who has seen this mistake a thousand times.

people.imagined: In his rooms at the music market at night, an old score unrolled before him, ink on his cuffs; he smiles tidily as someone comes in, and slides a cipher page under the score.
people.subject: The moment: in his rooms in the music market at night, an old score unrolled before him, he smiles tidily as someone comes in while one hand slides a cipher page under the score. Face: a smooth, calm, smiling, tidy face, a neat thin moustache, mild clever dark eyes, heavy eyelids, tiny creases at the corners of the eyes; ink-stained cuffs on both sleeves, black to the wrist, in front. Hair: black, parted and oiled, in a neat knot with a plain silver pin and a vermilion cord. Body: slim, tidy, upright, hands folded on the desk. Clothing: a flowing vermilion silk robe of a Truong Lão, crisp and clean, two crossed collars, gold phoenix-feather borders on the wide sleeves whose cuffs are black with ink, a dark red sash with a jade pendant, the hem edged with gold and green bands. Hands and objects: an old yellowed score scroll unrolled with small notes in dots; a bamboo flute on the desk, unplayed; one hand easing a loose page beneath the scroll. Power: a faint green shimmer of wood qi lies over the scroll like the echo of a tune, with a few pale motes. Background: a blurred shelf of old scrolls; through a window the lamp-lit lane of the market and a scrap of paper lantern in mist. Light: lamp spirit-light from the upper left, a pale gold rim on his oiled hair. Expression: polite and untroubled on the surface, the clever eyes heavy-lidded and calm while the hand works below.

people.imagined: The winter after Hỏa Ti Trấn burned: the first disciple standing at a roadside with her fan lowered, her face lit from below by the fire she carries inside her.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder's first disciple, the winter after Hỏa Ti Trấn burned: standing in a field of ash at dusk with her fan lowered, her face lit from below by the fire she carries inside her, looking at the viewer. Face: a strong, angular, broad-browed face, high cheekbones, a straight, proud nose, a firm wide mouth, deep-set dark eyes lit orange from below as if by a fire, a hint of ash at the eyelids, ash-streaked cheeks, a thin scar across the upper lip. Hair: black, long and loose, whipping to one side, a single gold flame hairpin. Body: tall, strong, broad-shouldered, upright, holding herself rigid as though bearing a great weight. Clothing: a long flowing vermilion silk robe of a commander with three crossed collars in vermilion, dawn-orange and white, wide sleeves scorched black at the cuffs over gold phoenix-feather embroidery, a dark red silk sash with a red jade disc, a short red-lacquered breastplate. Hands and objects: a large red feather fan, nine ribs, held lowered in her right hand, its edge charred. Power: a fierce red-gold glow of fire qi burns in her eyes and along the charred fan, embers drifting up round her like a halo of sparks. Background: a dark field of ash and a red sky; small figures walk away along a road in the distance, and a burned building frame stands to one side. Light: orange firelight from below and the left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: tired and fierce, the stern brow and set mouth of a woman who carried the fire so that others could walk away.

people.imagined: 760, with the zither on her lap, trying the eighth string. Her hand has gone still on it; she is listening to a note that has not come yet.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder's Dao partner, in the year 760, seated before a zither, trying the eighth string; her hand has gone still on it as she listens for a note that has not come yet. Face: a long, serene, devout, pale face, a high forehead, a long straight nose, closed thoughtful lids, a stubborn little set to the mouth; a faint line of fatigue shadows each eye. Hair: black, in a high knot with a plain jade pin and a thin silver comb. Body: slim, upright, seated with a straight back. Clothing: a flowing robe of grey-white silk with three crossed collars and long, wide gauze sleeves tied with a silk ribbon, a pale-green sash with a string of small jade chimes at her belt, the borders embroidered with faint gold clouds and phoenix feathers. Hands and objects: a long dark zither on her lap with eight silk strings, the last one snapped and curling; her left hand pressing, her right poised. Power: faint pale green and gold ripples of qi hover over the strings like the shape of an unheard sound. Background: a hall wall and a pale window, a bamboo screen and a vase with a single white flower, drifting mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: withdrawn and obstinate, a woman waiting for a note that will come only on her terms.

people.imagined: The siege line at Cô Thành, 722: the general standing before the walls, hand lifting to give the order for the fire, chin high.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the commander at the siege line of Cô Thành in 722, standing before the walls at dusk, one hand lifting to give the order for the fire, chin high. Face: a hard, handsome, wide-jawed face, a thick red-brown beard trimmed square, a hooked nose, flaring nostrils, fierce black eyes under heavy brows, a high, arrogant forehead. Hair: red-brown, tied in a high knot under a plain iron cap, a few long strands across his cheek. Body: tall, broad, heavy-shouldered, legs braced, chest out, a commander at ease with command. Clothing: a red-lacquered scale cuirass with gold flame inlay over a flowing vermilion silk robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves, a dark red cloak thrown back from his shoulders, a broad belt with a large red jade. Hands and objects: a closed red war fan in his left hand; his right hand held up, palm out; a short iron baton at his belt and a map case slung across his back. Power: a heavy red-orange glow of fire qi gathers round his raised hand and fan, a hot shimmer and sparks spreading toward the walls. Background: a line of siege towers and a column of black smoke climb behind him, and a few plain red banners show above the wall. Light: red dusk spirit-light from the left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: proud and hard, a look that does not question its own order.

people.imagined: 1042, the ninth day at Thủ Lôi Bảo: the master of the Hall of Righteousness stands in the gate of the burning fort, fan up, impatient to finish, as lightning gathers in the walls behind him.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the master of the Hall of Righteousness on the ninth day at Thủ Lôi Bảo in 1042, standing in the gate of the burning fort, fan up, glancing over his shoulder, impatient to finish as lightning gathers in the walls behind him. Face: a lean, strong, sun-dark face, a short black beard, a straight nose, glittering eager black eyes, a wide mouth open as if shouting an order, a streak of soot across one cheek, a trickle of sweat through the soot. Hair: black, in a high knot with a red cord, strands loose and singed, a few grey at the temples. Body: tall, wiry, taut, leaning forward. Clothing: a flowing vermilion silk robe with crossed collars and wide sleeves, scorched at the hem and embroidered with gold flames, a red-lacquered breastplate, a dark red sash, a narrow band of red silk tied round his upper arm, blackened boots. Hands and objects: a red feather fan lifted in his right hand, fanning an orange flame; a faint blue-white crackle at the stone wall behind him. Power: a bright red-gold glow of fire qi streams from the fan, sparks drifting like fireflies and a few forks of white-blue lightning. Background: a burning gate and red smoke. Light: orange firelight from the lower right. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: eager and fierce, the dark eyes bright, a man who wanted the fight over and is already shouting the next order.

people.imagined: The vein fort, 1154, on the pass in the early morning: a calm woman with a fan in one hand and a daughter's small hand in the other, looking out over the cinnabar vein before the day's work.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the warden of Đan Sơn Mạch on the pass in the early morning of 1154, standing on a ridge with a fan in one hand and looking calmly at the viewer, a daughter's small hand once held in her other. Face: a broad, calm, gentle face, wide-set grey-brown eyes, a firm jaw, soft full lips, a faint line between the brows; at her collar a small red jade pendant. Hair: black, in a low coil with a worn red-lacquered wooden hairpin carved with a small flame, a few grey hairs shining in it. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, upright, feet apart, a calm unhurried bearing. Clothing: a flowing vermilion silk robe with crossed collars over dawn-orange gauze, wide sleeves with a gold flame border, a red-lacquered breastplate, a dark red sash, the hem edged with gold and white bands. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a closed red feather fan, its twin missing; the left hand rests at her side. Power: a soft red-gold shimmer of fire qi rests round the fan and the jade, warm and steady, drawn in faded wash. Background: a red-brown ridge and a pale morning sky; a line of small tents and a fort wall on the ridge behind her, a few red banners fluttering, mist. Light: soft spirit-light from the upper left. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: kind and fair, a little tired, with the settled patience of someone who has already weighed the day.

people.imagined: 592, dawn at the burned town: a reeler's girl in a shed's doorway, ash on her hands, hanks of unburned silk held to her chest, offering them.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of a reeler's girl at dawn at the burned town in the year 592, standing in a charred shed doorway with ash on her hands, clutching hanks of orange silk to her chest and holding them out, offering them. Face: a young, thin, soot-streaked face, a small straight nose, large dark forgiving eyes, a trembling humble mouth, tear tracks through the ash on her cheeks, eyelashes singed short. Hair: black, in a plain braid, singed ends. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, young, shoulders hunched, feet bare in the ashes. Clothing: a plain brown silk-cotton reeler's jacket and skirt, scorched at the hem, an apron blackened with ash with a large patch of unburnt cloth sewn at the front, a cord of yellow silk tied round her wrist; a servant's plain dress, kept clean where it could be. Hands and objects: hanks of glowing orange-gold fire-silk held in both hands, bright against the black; a broken reeling frame leans against the doorpost beside her and a basket of blackened cocoons lies at her feet. Power: a warm orange-gold shimmer rises off the silk in her hands, soft motes of fire qi drifting up like the first light of the Nest. Background: a burnt shed and a smoky pink dawn. Light: pale dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a little orange glow from the silk. Painted as an old memorial portrait: faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened, fine cracks. Expression: wet-eyed and open, forgiving the fire, her whole face asking the viewer to take what she holds out.
